patterns.note: Hero section uses a prominent split layout, contrasting a large, bold headline with an interactive calendar UI mockup.
Headings utilize a bold, modern sans-serif typeface for strong hierarchy, complemented by a highly legible sans-serif for body text.
A stark white background and dark text are consistently punctuated by a vibrant, electric blue for primary calls to action and interactive elements.
The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, providing persistent access to site navigation.
Feature sections consistently integrate realistic, detailed UI mockups of the product to visually explain functionality alongside descriptive text.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header navigation that remains visible and accessible throughout the user's scroll journey.
Content sections are structured using a clean grid system, often presenting features or testimonials in balanced, multi-column layouts.
Interactive elements like buttons and input fields feature subtle corner rounding and consistent blue accenting to guide user interaction.

design_tokens.type_scale: large, bold display headings (approx. 3-4x body) with a clear hierarchy down to smaller, lighter labels
design_tokens.radius: subtle (buttons, cards, and UI elements have a consistent, slight corner rounding)
design_tokens.spacing: balanced, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a consistent, moderate padding within content blocks

standout: The site's distinctive use of a vibrant, electric blue as a singular accent color against a predominantly stark white and dark gray palette creates a highly modern, crisp, and professional aesthetic. This focused color strategy, combined with integrated, realistic product UI mockups, makes the product feel tangible and trustworthy.
